title: Taming the Machine — what AI regulation can learn from Wall Street & GDPR
excerpt: Regulate AI the way Wall Street and GDPR regulate systems that are too important to leave to trust — with structural safeguards, not slogans.

title: India's Global Narrative Gap — why the world often hears one side of the story
excerpt: Whoever controls the narrative controls the frame. India tells its story unevenly abroad — and the cost is measurable.

title: Political asylum is a privilege — the diaspora must acknowledge and nurture India's talent
excerpt: The diaspora's relationship with India is a two-way ledger — and asylum, framed carelessly, distorts both sides.

title: Norway's success story can be a blueprint for India's sustainable growth
excerpt: What a small Nordic economy has done deliberately over fifty years, India could adapt — if it decides sustainability is a system choice, not a slogan.
